text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after running through the Twinkle Series
and basking in the afterglow of reaching the major milestone of the 'first three years.'

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Good work, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Are you free this weekend? There's a place I'd love to take you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, where I was dragged off to was—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! It's an amusement park!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You've been my Trainer for these past three years, right? So I thought of this as a way to say thank you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Here, take my hand. I'll escort you!
What's your favorite ride?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then, led along by Fuji Kiseki,
I ended up riding the merry-go-round with her—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Look over here!
I'm taking a picture!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ride the roller coaster—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, it's fine.
I'm right here with you, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We ate lunch, watched the parade—
and had a blast at the amusement park with Fuji Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! That was scary! The one that popped out right after letting our guard down was definitely the scariest.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's getting pretty late.
Shall we wrap things up here?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What do you want to do?
Should the ferris wheel be the finale after all?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as we stood in line at dusk
waiting for the Ferris wheel—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer-san.
Did you have fun today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, Fuji Kiseki asked me that
with a deadly serious look on her face.
choice_data_list: Of course, it was a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Great! Honestly, I've always wanted the chance
to do something for you one day.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Do you remember when I moved up to the Senior Year
and completely lost my composure?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was probably right around the end of the Yasuda Kinen.
Back then, Fuji Kiseki was pushed to her absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Back then... when I pushed past my limits and consulted with you, I bounced back shockingly fast.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The fact that you cheered me on so desperately was a huge part of it, of course, but it wasn't just that—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Knowing there was someone waiting for me in the wings
made me naturally straighten my back."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's not all.
Around the end of the Senior year, when the Arima Kinen was over—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, I actually thought taking things a bit easy
might not be so bad.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I thought about consulting with you, went through the underground tunnel,
and the moment I saw you waiting there with a smile—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Any thought of taking it easy
had vanished into thin air.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, what should we do next?!
What kind of miracle shall I show them?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Together, we can go anywhere!
...That's truly how I felt.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Your presence was what gave me
the resolve to face this grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If you hadn't been there, I might have
stepped down from the stage once again."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're my benefactor.
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And Fuji Kiseki quietly knelt before me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Will you stay by my side from now on, too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hand in hand, she pulled me along, and right at
that exact moment, the Ferris wheel arrived—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Come on, hop on, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Beyond the window of the Ferris wheel, amid a sky painted in shades of red and blue, a single evening star shone brighter than all the rest.
